title: Invertibility of the twice-transposed unit
statement: Let C,A,B be categories and Lm adjoint to Rm, Ln adjoint to Rn, and L adjoint to R, with an isomorphism e:R Rm -> Rn. The transpose through Lm of the final unit followed by e inverse, transposed once more through L, is invertible. It is the component of the canonical left-adjoint composition isomorphism. No geometry is involved.

lean.statement:
theorem adjunct_isIso
    {C A B : Type*} [Category C] [Category A] [Category B]
    {Lm : C ⥤ A} {Rm : A ⥤ C} {Ln : C ⥤ B} {Rn : B ⥤ C}
    {L : A ⥤ B} {R : B ⥤ A}
    (am : Lm ⊣ Rm) (an : Ln ⊣ Rn) (a : L ⊣ R) (e : R ⋙ Rm ≅ Rn) (K : C) :
    IsIso ((a.homEquiv _ _).symm
      ((am.homEquiv _ _).symm (an.unit.app K ≫ e.inv.app (Ln.obj K))))
